passRequirements.identity-set: pinned exact fixture hash and exact set membership
passRequirements.raw-inventory: source record is preserved with original annotations and provenance
passRequirements.direct-match: all candidates are parsed under a reviewed annotation policy; no stripping by guess
passRequirements.fallback-render: actual target browser render evidence with source unchanged
passRequirements.reverse-split: one unique IDS or explicit candidate picker; selection is preserved and undoable
passRequirements.roundtrip-join: exact source transaction, output identity and undo/redo evidence
passRequirements.font-cmap: pinned local font cmap and coverage evidence
passRequirements.outline-export: actual generated file opens and passes SVG structural checks
passRequirements.same-font-pixels: pinned font, renderer, pixel size and comparison tolerances
passRequirements.browsers: browser/OS versions, exact full-case matrix and visual artifacts

noDegradation: A previously unique direct mapping that becomes missing/ambiguous/failing blocks the audit.
releaseGate: blocked until all required data stages and native/browser stages are complete
